stage0038_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カヲル$$
「As always, that's a good song.」

stage0038_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カヲル$$
「There's someone I want to hear
　your song... Is that all right?」

stage0038_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$赤木$$
「Good... everyone made it here on time.」

stage0038_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course!
　$$かおる$$ and $$マッキー$$ are both here too!」

stage0038_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$赤木$$
「All right, we're heading out now for
　the Ancient Civilization Expo, being held
　at the Odaiba event venue!」

stage0038_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Heh heh... I was so excited
　I could hardly sleep last night.」

stage0038_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$かおる$$
「Are you sure, $$ワッ太$$?
　This is your first day off since
　getting back to Japan...」

stage0038_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's fine, it's fine, $$かおる$$!
　It's the hot Ancient Civilization Expo!」

stage0038_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Besides, it's a date with you, $$かおる$$!
　No way I could just sleep in!」

stage0038_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But this is such a popular event,
　how'd you get tickets?」

stage0038_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$赤木$$
「I suppose that's because $$マッキー$$'s father,
　Dr. $$敷島$$, helped with the ruins survey?」

stage0038_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$マッキー$$
「That's part of it, but actually...」

stage0038_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シモン$$
「Because I'm the one who found that civilization.」

stage0038_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Before I joined up with $c,
　Dr. $$敷島$$ asked me to help with a dig.」

stage0038_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$シモン$$
「He saw promise in my digging skills.」

stage0038_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Ohh, that gives me chills!
　That's a digger's dream come true!」

stage0038_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$赤木$$
「Anyway!
　Today's $c's first day off in a while!」

stage0038_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$赤木$$
「Thanks to $$シモン$$, we got the tickets,
　so let's enjoy ourselves!」

stage0038_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$いぶき$$
「You've really become quite the chaperone, $$赤木$$.」

stage0038_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$青山$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s perfect for teenagers, but
　for grade schoolers, $$赤木$$ might suit better.」

stage0038_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Though one of those teenagers is here too...」

stage0038_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Man, you've got time to kill, $n...
　tagging along with $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$
　to look at mummies and stone tablets.」

stage0038_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And it happens to be mine too.」

stage0038_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Didn't see that coming...
　Miss $$スズネ$$, into the occult...」

stage0038_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Speaking of which, $$アンディ$$,
　why are you here with us anyway?」

stage0038_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I've got no interest in mummies.
　But the special guests? Very interested!」

stage0038_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$木下$$
「That's right!
　The event's got a stage with Lady $$シェリル$$
　and $$ランカ$$ too, after all!」

stage0038_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$シモン$$
「I finally get to see $$ランカ$$ sing live
　after all this time.
　There's no way I'm missing this.」

stage0038_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ダリー$$
「$$シモン$$... you really are a huge fan
　of $$ランカ$$'s, aren't you.」

stage0038_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Tch... $$シェリル$$'s way cooler, though.」

stage0038_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$木下$$
「Oh, $$ギミー$$!
　Switching to Team $$シェリル$$ is exactly
　what a boy trying to act grown-up would say!」

stage0038_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Wh, what's that supposed to mean!
　It's not like that at all!」

stage0038_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's fine, it's fine, $$ギミー$$.
　Liking $$シェリル$$ proves you're a healthy young man.
　...Right, $$ＭＩＸ$$?」

stage0038_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$クルツ$$!
　Where are you even looking!?」

stage0038_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Where, you ask... right, $$アンディ$$?」

stage0038_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's like witnessing the birth of the universe...!」

stage0038_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's enough, you two.
　I won't allow any more of that in front
　of $$かおる$$ and $$マッキー$$...!」

stage0038_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Honestly...
　There might be a huge academic discovery here,
　and yet, boys...」

stage0038_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$n
「This Ancient Civilization Expo has exhibits
　from many eras and regions, but...」

stage0038_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$n
「The most attention-grabbing of them is that capsule.
　After all, it was found in a stratum
　from about 12,000 years ago.」

stage0038_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$スズネ$$
「12,000 years ago... that's still the Stone Age.」

stage0038_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$n
「It's astonishing a civilization left traces then,
　and its relics survived in perfect condition,
　so its academic value is beyond measure.」

stage0038_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$マッキー$$
「My dad's supposed to be there too
　when they open the capsule.」

stage0038_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Exciting, huh, $$正太郎$$.
　What if a ghost pops out of it?」

stage0038_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If that happened, everyone would panic.」

stage0038_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then what do you think should come out, $$正太郎$$?」

stage0038_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's see...
　If someone from that era was sleeping
　there, and we could be friends...」

stage0038_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ウラジミール$$
「...Everyone visiting the Ancient
　Civilization Expo. This is the site of
　the capsule opening.」

stage0038_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ウラジミール$$
「We'll bring you the moment of opening
　live, through the monitors around the venue.」

stage0038_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Hey... isn't that $$ウラジミール$$?」

stage0038_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Yeah...
　She runs an event company these days,
　and does reporter work herself too, apparently.」

stage0038_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「$$ウラジミール$$ gave us these Ancient
　Civilization Expo tickets, too.」

stage0038_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$アルト$$
「And she's squeezing in a $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$
　stage on top of that... quite the operator.」

stage0038_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「I hear the world the Frontier fleet
　came from has ties to ancient civilization.
　That's probably why they were invited.」

stage0038_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, it's an Ancient Civilization Expo...」

stage0038_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Lately... archaeological discoveries have
　been happening one after another everywhere.
　It's like an ancient civilization boom.」

stage0038_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アルト$$
「In a multiverse where worlds of different
　histories merged, I doubt it means much...」

stage0038_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アルト$$
「But is this really okay...?
　No matter how I look at it, I feel like
　I'm intruding on your date...」

stage0038_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Then how about we make it a double date?」

stage0038_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't tell me this is really happening...!?」

stage0038_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Looks like she just got here.」

stage0038_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$...
　Is it really okay for you to be out here?」

stage0038_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ランカ$$
「...Yeah...
　I really wanted to talk to $$アルト$$
　before the stage...」

stage0038_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アルト$$
「Anyway, we're too exposed here.
　We need to do something about it...」

stage0038_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Everyone's watching the capsule opening,
　so the beach should be less crowded right now.」

stage0038_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アルト$$
「All right... let's go, $$ランカ$$.」

stage0038_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「But was that really all right...?
　Leaving $$ランカ$$ and $$アルト$$ alone together
　isn't quite fair to $$シェリル$$, is it...」

stage0038_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「It's fine.
　I'm the one who pilots Dancouga, after all.」

stage0038_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Never mind.
　More importantly, let's enjoy our date too.」

stage0038_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「...That's too bad.
　The live capsule-opening broadcast
　got cancelled.」

stage0038_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Maybe they found something inside
　that just couldn't be shown to the public.」

stage0038_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Like, an actual ghost or something...!」

stage0038_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Honestly, $$ワッ太$$!
　Don't try to scare me!」

stage0038_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Ahaha...!
　You're such a scaredy-cat, $$マッキー$$!」

stage0038_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
???
「What is this place?
　Why are there so many humans here?」

stage0038_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$かおる$$
「Stop that, $$ワッ太$$.
　This kid... might be from another country.」

stage0038_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$マッキー$$
「You're right...
　Their clothes look unfamiliar.」

stage0038_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
???
「That's not it.
　I'm just assessing the situation right now.」

stage0038_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ワッ太$$
（He's probably lost.
　Let's hand him off to the cops before it's a hassle）

stage0038_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$正太郎$$
（What are you talking about, $$ワッ太$$.
　I'm with $$ＩＣＰＯ$$）

stage0038_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Sorry.
　We were just discussing something」

stage0038_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You seem unfamiliar with this area.
　If you'd like, we could show you around」

stage0038_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm $$金田正太郎$$.
　And you are...?」

stage0038_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$, huh...
　Nice to meet you」

stage0038_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm $$竹尾ワッ太$$!
　Anyway, I'm starving,
　let's get crepes or ice cream」

stage0038_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「They're kinds of sweets.
　They're good」

stage0038_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Very well.
　I shall eat them」

stage0038_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$かおる$$
（I knew it, he must be a foreigner）

stage0038_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$マッキー$$
（But he has a certain elegance,
　like some country's prince...）

stage0038_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Come on, let's go, $$グーラ$$」

stage0038_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アルト$$
「...Something's bothering you, isn't it, $$ランカ$$?」

stage0038_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's why you had $$エイーダ$$
　set up a meeting with me, right?」

stage0038_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ランカ$$
「You really do see right through me, $$アルト$$...」

stage0038_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even I can listen when something's bothering you.
　Go ahead, tell me」

stage0038_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ランカ$$
「My singing... maybe it's no good anymore...」

stage0038_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about?
　Look how many people came to Odaiba
　today just to hear you sing」

stage0038_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ランカ$$
「But... it didn't reach the Vajra...」

stage0038_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アルト$$
「You mean back in $$アクエリア市$$」

stage0038_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$'s singing was the same,
　so what does she say about it?」

stage0038_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ランカ$$
「$$シェリル$$ seemed shocked too, I think...
　So neither of us brings it up anymore」

stage0038_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're just tired, you and $$シェリル$$ both.
　Ever since the $$新世時空震動$$ hit, it's been
　nonstop events and ceremonies everywhere」

stage0038_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アルト$$
「We've still got time before the stage.
　Go look at the sea, take it easy」

stage0038_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アルト$$
（I don't remember the last time
　I saw $$ランカ$$ this down...）

stage0038_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$...
　Next I want to ride that giant wheel」

stage0038_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's the Ferris wheel, $$グーラ$$」

stage0038_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「H-hold on a sec!
　Let's take a break!」

stage0038_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$グーラ$$
「How pathetic.
　Then I'll go with $$正太郎$$」

stage0038_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait!
　Nobody said I wasn't going!」

stage0038_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$, $$ワッ太$$, you two need to get along.
　We're having such a fun time, after all」

stage0038_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$マッキー$$
「$$グーラ$$ really does have a different air
　about him than $$正太郎$$ or $$ワッ太$$」

stage0038_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$かおる$$
「He really might be some country's prince」

stage0038_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Then if I married $$グーラ$$, wouldn't that
　make me a princess!」

stage0038_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$マッキー$$
「What's wrong, Papa?
　You're in such a rush」

stage0038_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$敷島$$
「That boy was asleep inside a capsule!」

stage0038_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「A capsule... from the ancient civilization exhibit!?」

stage0038_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$敷島$$
「That's right.
　It seems it was some kind of cryo-sleep device」

stage0038_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$敷島$$
「Once we learned someone was asleep inside,
　we cut the live broadcast, but once he woke,
　he slipped out of the lab」

stage0038_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$グーラ$$
「What that man says isn't wrong」

stage0038_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...
　Just who are you...」

stage0038_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...It seems my escort has arrived」

stage0038_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Remember, $$グーラ$$.
　You were sent to this planet to live on,
　beyond the cycle of reincarnation」

stage0038_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You are the one who shall rule this Earth...
　$$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$」

stage0038_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I am... $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...!
　The prince who shall rule Earth!」

stage0038_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Is this... an illusion cast by the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!?」

stage0038_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$グーラ$$
「It seems you've learned my father's power,
　Earthling」

stage0038_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Him...!
　He was the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son!」

stage0038_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$ダンカン$$...
　Prepare a $$スペースロボ$$ for me」

stage0038_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop it, $$グーラ$$!
　You mustn't fight!!」

stage0038_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I won't take orders from you...!」

stage0038_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Futile, Earthlings.
　You've entered the Age of the Sun, and already
　walk the road to ruin」

stage0038_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Beyond the cycle of reincarnation, $$グーラ$$ shall
　rule this planet. Death awaits any who interfere」

stage0038_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Still, I was surprised by Fire Bomber's
　sudden joining up with us」

stage0038_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「We were just as surprised, believe me」

stage0038_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Technically we're with Vector Promotion,
　but we've been touring the world at our own pace」

stage0038_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Then one morning $$バサラ$$ suddenly said he
　wanted to go to Japan, and here we are」

stage0038_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$桂$$
「$$ガムリン$$'s stress from being dragged along
　shows in how his forehead keeps receding」

stage0038_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$モーム$$
「$$桂$$'s just joking, $$ガムリン$$.
　Your forehead's only receded five
　millimeters since we last met」

stage0038_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「So it really has receded...」

stage0038_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$桂$$
「Well... that's the weakness of
　being smitten. Anyway, nice work
　on bodyguard duty」

stage0038_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Don't tell me, $$ガムリン$$ and $$熱気バサラ$$...」

stage0038_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Stop it, $$サザンカ$$.
　Don't go spreading your own
　abnormal tastes to everyone else」

stage0038_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's true that I'm smitten with $$バサラ$$」

stage0038_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Don't misunderstand.
　What I'm smitten with is $$バサラ$$'s way of life」

stage0038_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$モロイ$$
「A man falling for another man...
　Does $$熱気バサラ$$ have that much charm?」

stage0038_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$桂$$
「Don't dodge the question, $$ガムリン$$.
　What I want to know is whether things
　with $$ミレーヌ$$ have moved forward at all.」

stage0038_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Aww... so it's a normal pairing after all...」

stage0038_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Well, since some faces here are new,
　let me introduce myself.
　I'm $$ミレーヌ・Ｆ・ジーナス$$, vocals and bass.」

stage0038_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「I'm $$レイ・ラブロック$$.
　Keyboard's my part.
　And this is $$ビヒーダ・フィーズ$$, on drums.」

stage0038_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$クラン$$
「Impressive stickwork as always,
　$$ビヒーダ$$.」

stage0038_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So, where's this famous $$熱気バサラ$$?」

stage0038_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$ is the son of the
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, our... Earth's enemy...
　So...」

stage0038_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Is that really how you feel?」

stage0038_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't lie to your heart.
　Keep forcing a lid on your burning
　feelings, and it'll blow up someday.」

stage0038_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$'s right, $$正太郎$$.
　You don't really want to fight $$グーラ$$,
　do you?」

stage0038_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Alright, you two!
　Don't ever forget that burning heart!」

stage0038_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whoa, $$バサラ$$!
　Play 'DYNAMITE EXPLOSION' for us!」

stage0038_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Good taste, $$アンディ$$.
　That song's a true classic!」

stage0038_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$アンディ$$
「C-captain... where'd you come from?」

stage0038_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'm asking too, $$バサラ$$!
　Let me request 'DYNAMITE EXPLOSION'!」

stage0038_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I'm just not in the mood right now.」

stage0038_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I-I see...
　But hearing it sung without the right
　feeling would be sad too, it's true...」

stage0038_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$オズマ$$
「As a fan, I suppose all I can do
　is choke back tears and bear it...」

stage0038_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$バサラ$$
「But next time, I'll bring my best.
　Look forward to it.」

stage0038_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Amusing, isn't it, Captain $$オズマ$$?」

stage0038_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Unusual, $$シュレード$$.
　You, coming down to the hangar.」

stage0038_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Hearing a song that loud and free,
　even I can't just sit still.」

stage0038_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Welcome, $$熱気バサラ$$.
　Combine your light with my shadow,
　and a new melody will be born.」

stage0038_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That's something to look forward to.
　When do we do it?」

stage0038_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That time isn't far off...
　That's the feeling I get.」

stage0038_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$タケル$$
「Unexpected. A session between
　classical $$シュレード$$ and rock $$バサラ$$.」

stage0038_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$n
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ knew Mayan words...
　But I hear $$グーラ$$'s capsule was around
　12,000 years old...」

stage0038_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$n
「Just knowing of Mayan civilization was
　surprising, but $$グーラ$$'s father, the
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, has lived 12,000 years.」

stage0038_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$n
「The power of a black hole, and the
　fact he's lived through eons of time...」

stage0038_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「The scale is fundamentally different
　from any enemy we've fought before.」

stage0038_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$n
（And that phrase from the Mayan
　civilization... Why does he keep
　repeating that old doomsday prophecy...）

stage0038_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text: ～ $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ Army $$巨大円盤$$ Bridge ～

stage0038_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Welcome back, Your Highness $$グーラ$$.
　I offer my heartfelt congratulations
　on your awakening.」

stage0038_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ロビー$$
「I am $$ロビー$$, an intelligence robot.
　Your father, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　charged me to serve as your advisor.」

stage0038_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I have heard of this, Your Highness.
　That Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ possesses a
　robot packed with all universal knowledge.」

stage0038_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「So this is that $$ロビー$$.」

stage0038_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ロビー$$
「It's a pleasure, Master
　$$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$.」

stage0038_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Then answer my question, $$ロビー$$.
　Where is Father?」

stage0038_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「The Father I knew wasn't that
　huge a form.」

stage0038_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ロビー$$
「After putting Your Highness to sleep,
　your father became the incarnation
　of a black hole himself.」

stage0038_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ロビー$$
「That is a mystery of the universe,
　one even I, $$ロビー$$, cannot fathom.」

stage0038_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Your father can freely soar among
　the galaxy's stars, and send his
　shadow anywhere, as he did today.」

stage0038_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ロビー$$
「And within his body, every truth
　of the universe has been drawn in.」

stage0038_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Indeed. Your father is the very
　demon king who reigns over the
　universe.」

stage0038_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$グーラ$$
「And that father entrusted me with
　conquering Earth...」

stage0038_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「What are your orders, Your Highness?」

stage0038_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Today's battle convinced me.
　That $c is the greatest obstacle
　between my father and me.」

stage0038_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I agree with you as well.」

stage0038_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「First, I'll prepare. Then I'll challenge
　them to a decisive battle, and sweep away
　every obstacle to conquering Earth at once!」

stage0038_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$グーラ$$
（Prepare yourself, $c.
　And you too, $$金田正太郎$$.）

stage0038_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$グーラ$$
（I am $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...
　I swear on this name that I
　will defeat you.）

stage0038_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$ワッ太$$...!
　I was deeply moved by the words you
　used to persuade $$グーラ$$!」

stage0038_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of the straightforward
　Master $$竹尾ワッ太$$! A true man among men,
　a nice guy who knows friendship's meaning!」

stage0038_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「My old man always told me to
　treasure my friends.」

stage0038_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So those words were spoken out of
　concern for Master $$正太郎$$, weren't they.」

stage0038_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Not just $$正太郎$$.
　$$グーラ$$ too.」

stage0038_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「He, I, and $$正太郎$$ each inherited our
　own place from our fathers, but deep down,
　we're supposed to be friends.」

stage0038_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wonderful! A person like you is
　exactly who should lead others!」

stage0038_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Moved by your words today, Master
　$$ワッ太$$, the Director has refined
　some lovely Z-Chips for you.」

stage0038_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... 150Z!
　I'll add it to the squad's stock.」

stage0038_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If anything, I'd rather have had cash,
　not Z-Chips, added to my own company's
　safe instead.」

stage0038_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... my respect meter for Master
　$$ワッ太$$ just dropped a little...」

stage0038_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've been waiting for you, Master
　$$バサラ$$!」

stage0038_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I am an agent of $$ＤＥＭ$$,
　$$ＡＧ$$, at your service.」

stage0038_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$バサラ$$'s soul shout is a
　detonator that shakes the heart!
　Truly, DYNAMITE EXPLOSION!」

stage0038_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, how about releasing an album
　under my production?
　The Z-Chips would surely roll in.」

stage0038_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Sorry, but I've got no interest
　in that. I do things my own way.」

stage0038_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait, please!
　At least lend your power to $$ＤＥＭ$$,
　Master $$バサラ$$!」

stage0038_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$バサラ$$
「What exactly do you want me to do?」

stage0038_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please shout together with me!
　Here we go!」

stage0038_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today too, let's get fired up...
　business, business! Intensely!!」

stage0038_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Somehow this ended up feeling
　like a bankruptcy clearance sale...」
